name: Bellingham Spring 2024
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BellinghamSpring2024#40148-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **All students of Western Washington University may register free of charge! Please pay for your registration as normal, then [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=BellinghamSpring2024) with a picture of your student ID to receive a full refund.** [![Image description](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/published/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)
